remarks: To be recorded as a decision record
text: Field instruments and control valve positioners use 4-20 mA HART; PROFIBUS PA and FOUNDATION Fieldbus are not used for field devices and PROFIBUS DP is not used between the DCS and the packages (DEC-EPCE-0017). Reasons: (a) the diagnostics of the instruments are available by HART without fieldbus segments; (b) a wiring failure affects a single loop, not a segment of several instruments and valves; (c) fewer protocols reduce the engineering, spare parts, testing and the cybersecurity attack surface of the IEC 62443 conduits; (d) the TCS integration is by OPC UA. Package PLCs and smart devices communicate by Modbus TCP or OPC UA; MV protection relays by IEC 61850.
